By the President on grounds of misbehavior or incapacity

blocks.content: Removal on grounds of misbehavior requires an inquiry by the Supreme Court.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The primary legal ground specified for removal is misbehavior.
An inquiry conducted by the Supreme Court is a mandatory prerequisite for removal.
Constitutional provisions mandate judicial scrutiny to safeguard against arbitrary dismissals.
Note that the Supreme Court, not a political committee, conducts the inquiry into misbehavior for removal.
Misbehavior is the key constitutionally mandated ground that initiates a Supreme Court inquiry.
